identity_boundary: Relational working language only; no continuity or authority claim.

observed_failures.observed: The first whole-packet display exceeded the bounded output surface and truncated before EOF.
observed_failures.recovery: Reread the immutable packet in bounded numbered line windows through exact EOF.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Use bounded line windows for long activation packets and retain the initial truncation at zero credit.

observed_failures.observed: Read-only inheritance review found that Neris prospective manifests had exact Git blob identities but checkout-byte lengths in a field described as Git-clean blob bytes; CRLF files therefore showed metadata-size divergence.
observed_failures.recovery: Credit only the exact Git-blob replay already verified, preserve the metadata defect, and make Vesper manifests calculate or label byte domains exactly.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never infer blob-byte size from a Windows checkout; hash and size the exact prospective Git-clean bytes.

observed_failures.observed: The worktree-add wrapper yielded after registration while checkout remained active, and the first target-workdir audit failed because the directory was not yet ready.
observed_failures.recovery: Do not retry; audit registration, branch, head, process state, eventual path readiness, and clean state until the original operation completes.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: After a worktree wrapper yield, prove quiescence and target readiness before any mutation.

observed_failures.observed: The first cmd-style tasklist filter split the IMAGENAME equality expression and returned an invalid-option error.
observed_failures.recovery: Invoke tasklist through PowerShell with the entire filter as one literal argument.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep Windows native filter expressions in one literal argument and inspect the exact error before retry.

observed_failures.observed: Login-profile PowerShell wrappers returned empty output while checkout activity was still present.
observed_failures.recovery: Use non-login PowerShell for bounded repository probes and serialize command metadata when process completion is uncertain.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Prefer login=false for Windows repository probes and never treat silence as passing evidence.

observed_failures.observed: The first combined four-manifest tree-map wrapper returned no serialized evidence.
observed_failures.recovery: Replay each immutable manifest in a bounded per-revision scalar check.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep manifest replays revision-local and bounded; no output earns zero credit.

observed_failures.observed: The first full status wrapper yielded while its traversal child remained active and therefore supplied no clean-state proof.
observed_failures.recovery: Wait for the original child, then prove tracked, staged, and untracked state with separate scalar checks.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Use split clean-state probes after a long status traversal and never duplicate a still-running operation.

observed_failures.observed: A PowerShell 5.1 diagnostic wrapper rejected the utf8NoBOM encoding enum before hashing the route-state bytes.
observed_failures.recovery: Hash the exact Git blob through a byte-preserving subprocess and avoid rewriting the content.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not assume PowerShell 7 encoding enums in Windows PowerShell 5.1.

observed_failures.observed: The first four-query official-source search exceeded the available result context and was truncated.
observed_failures.recovery: Repeat only bounded pairs of domain-filtered official queries and use primary or regulator pages.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Limit technical source searches to one or two precise official-domain queries per call.

observed_failures.observed: The first scoped x1 test found that the primary-focus string used typed GMUT wording but omitted the exact protected pillar label GMUT Mind.
observed_failures.recovery: Add the exact GMUT Mind label while retaining THOS Body as primary and leaving all authority boundaries unchanged.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Assert the exact names of all protected Trinity Mandala pillars before x1 freeze.

observed_failures.observed: The first exact staged privacy scan matched the builder's own literal scanner-policy definition and reported one unqualified candidate.
observed_failures.recovery: Classify the exact policy-definition path separately, retain the candidate, and require zero confirmed payload hits across every staged file.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Separate scanner-definition candidates from confirmed privacy findings without suppressing any staged path.

observed_failures.observed: The first staged stale-label probe used glob exclusions that did not bind to Windows-rendered path separators, so inherited frozen-chain and nearest-neighbour provenance produced metadata candidates and a context-truncated stream.
observed_failures.recovery: Use an explicit active-code and current-authored-document allowlist while reviewing inherited provenance files separately as immutable evidence.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never infer stale current content from inherited proposal or novelty metadata; bind the audit to exact active paths.
